content: EA FC chemistry (cross-checked: FootballGPT, TeamGullit, OperationSports, Red Bull): chemistry gives stat bonuses only (0 chemistry = no penalty), 0-3 per player, team total 33. Links form from shared nation/league/club; position must match. FC26 simplified: no adjacency requirement, any lineup member links to any other. Bonuses scale with chemistry value. Design implication for 3 main + 9 buffer slots: faction/role affinity links are the collectible-driver (need diverse factions to fill slots), bonuses-only keeps it friendly, and a simple 3-tier link (same faction / same role / neither) is enough - avoid deep adjacency math.
